<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Abdul Hannan — AI Commercials / 3D Portfolio</title>
<meta name="description" content="Abdul Hannan — AI commercial ads, cinematic product visuals and motion concepts.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root{--bg:#050507;--panel:#0b0b0f;--text:#f7f7f4;--muted:#9a9aa5;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.13);--lime:#c9ff45;--violet:#a77bff;--cyan:#5eeaff;--red:#ff4d62}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-5;background:radial-gradient(circle at 80% 10%,rgba(167,123,255,.12),transparent 25%),radial-gradient(circle at 10% 65%,rgba(94,234,255,.07),transparent 25%)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}button{font:inherit}.wrap{width:min(1240px,calc(100% - 42px));margin:auto}.noise{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:50;opacity:.055;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 180 180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.8'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}.cursor{position:fixed;width:300px;height:300px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:40;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(201,255,69,.1),transparent 65%);mix-blend-mode:screen}
.nav{position:fixed;z-index:30;left:0;right:0;top:0;padding:16px 0}.navbox{height:62px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:rgba(7,7,9,.68);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 18px;box-shadow:0 15px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}.brand{font:700 16px "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:-.04em}.brand i{color:var(--lime);font-style:normal}.links{display:flex;gap:25px;color:#aaa;font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em}.links a:hover{color:#fff}.navbtn{padding:10px 15px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:#070709;font-weight:700;font-size:12px}
.hero{min-height:100vh;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center}.hero canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 67% 47%,transparent 0 17%,rgba(5,5,7,.22) 45%,#050507 83%)}.grid{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:42%;opacity:.18;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.1) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.1) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:70px 70px;transform:perspective(600px) rotateX(62deg) scale(1.4);transform-origin:bottom}
.hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:3;padding-top:70px;max-width:820px}.eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lime);margin-bottom:16px}.hero h1{font:600 clamp(64px,10vw,145px)/.82 "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:-.085em;max-width:8.8ch}.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(255,255,255,.7)}.hero p{margin-top:28px;color:#aaaab4;font-size:17px;line-height:1.7;max-width:580px}.actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px}.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:14px 18px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;transition:.3s}.btn.primary{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime);color:#090a06}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}.hero-label{position:absolute;right:5%;top:27%;z-index:3;color:#777;font:11px "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:.12em;writing-mode:vertical-rl}.scroll{position:absolute;bottom:25px;z-index:3;font-size:10px;color:#666;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
.section{padding:130px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);position:relative}.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:30px;margin-bottom:48px}.section-head h2{font:600 clamp(40px,6vw,78px)/.9 "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:-.065em;max-width:720px}.section-head h2 span{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(255,255,255,.65)}.head-copy{max-width:350px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}
.service-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}.service{min-height:300px;padding:26px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05),rgba(255,255,255,.01));border-radius:24px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:.35s}.service:hover{border-color:rgba(201,255,69,.4);transform:translateY(-8px)}.service .outline{position:absolute;right:-50px;top:-50px;width:180px;height:180px;border:1px solid rgba(201,255,69,.35);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 18px rgba(201,255,69,.025),0 0 0 40px rgba(201,255,69,.018)}.service .num{color:#5f5f69;font:12px "Space Grotesk"}.service h3{font:600 30px "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:90px 0 10px}.service p{color:#9999a4;line-height:1.65;font-size:13px}
.lab{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:32px;min-height:690px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,rgba(167,123,255,.13),transparent 35%),#08080b}.lab canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}.lab-copy{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:5%;top:7%;max-width:390px}.lab-copy h2{font:600 clamp(42px,6vw,76px)/.88 "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:-.065em}.lab-copy p{color:#9999a4;line-height:1.65;font-size:14px;margin-top:18px}.lab-stamp{position:absolute;right:5%;bottom:7%;z-index:3;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:50%;width:110px;height:110px;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;color:#777;font:10px "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.work-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:16px}.work-card{grid-column:span 6;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#09090c;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:border-color .3s;will-change:transform}.work-card:nth-child(1),.work-card:nth-child(4){grid-column:span 7}.work-card:nth-child(2),.work-card:nth-child(5){grid-column:span 5}.work-card:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}.work-media{height:430px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#111}.work-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .8s;filter:saturate(.92)}.work-card:hover .work-media img{transform:scale(1.07)}.media-scan{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 40%,rgba(0,0,0,.65)),linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 70%,rgba(255,255,255,.05));pointer-events:none}.media-scan:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:1px;background:rgba(201,255,69,.8);box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(201,255,69,.8);animation:scan 4s linear infinite}@keyframes scan{0%{top:0;opacity:0}10%{opacity:1}90%{opacity:1}100%{top:100%;opacity:0}}.work-media .num{position:absolute;left:18px;top:16px;font:11px "Space Grotesk";color:#fff;z-index:2}.pill{position:absolute;right:16px;top:14px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;z-index:2}.view{position:absolute;right:17px;bottom:16px;font:11px "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:.12em;z-index:2}.work-body{padding:21px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:start}.work-body h3{font:600 25px "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:-.045em}.work-body p{color:#888894;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;margin-top:7px;max-width:540px}.tag{white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:7px 9px;border-radius:999px;color:#777;font-size:10px}
.commercials{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}.video-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;background:#08080b;position:relative}.video-card video{width:100%;height:390px;display:block;object-fit:cover;background:#000}.video-meta{padding:18px 20px 21px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}.video-meta h3{font:600 24px "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:-.04em}.video-meta p{font-size:12px;color:#777;line-height:1.55;margin-top:6px}.video-meta .type{color:var(--lime);font:10px "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.process{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px}.process h2{font:600 clamp(42px,6vw,76px)/.9 "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:-.065em}.steps{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.step{display:grid;grid-template-columns:60px 1fr;gap:15px;padding:25px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.step b{font:12px "Space Grotesk";color:var(--lime)}.step h3{font:600 21px "Space Grotesk"}.step p{color:#888894;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;margin-top:7px}
.contact{padding:145px 0 90px;text-align:center}.contact h2{font:600 clamp(52px,9vw,110px)/.82 "Space Grotesk";letter-spacing:-.08em}.contact h2 span{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px #fff}.contact p{color:#888894;max-width:520px;margin:25px auto 28px;line-height:1.7;font-size:14px}.socials{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.social{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:11px 15px;font-size:11px;transition:.25s}.social:hover{border-color:var(--lime);transform:translateY(-3px)}footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 0 30px;color:#60606a;font-size:11px}footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(35px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease}.reveal.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(max-width:850px){.links{display:none}.wrap{width:min(100% - 28px,700px)}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(58px,16vw,94px)}.hero p{font-size:15px}.section{padding:95px 0}.section-head{display:block}.head-copy{margin-top:17px}.service-grid,.commercials,.process{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lab{min-height:590px}.work-grid{display:block}.work-card{margin-bottom:15px}.work-media{height:330px}.video-card video{height:300px}.lab-copy{left:7%;right:7%}.lab-stamp{width:88px;height:88px;font-size:8px}footer .wrap{display:block}footer span{display:block;margin-top:7px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style>
</head>

<section class="hero"><canvas id="hero3d"></canvas><div class="grid"></div><div class="wrap"><div class="hero-copy reveal"><div class="eyebrow">AI COMMERCIAL ADS · CREATIVE STUDIO</div><h1>MAKE IT <em>MOVE.</em><br>MAKE IT <span style="color:var(--lime)">SELL.</span></h1><p>I'm Abdul Hannan — I create cinematic AI commercials, product visuals and social-first ad concepts with a strong 3D / motion aesthetic.</p><div class="actions"><a class="btn primary" href="#work">Explore commercials ↗</a><a class="btn" href="#lab">Enter 3D Lab</a></div></div></div><div class="hero-label">3D / MOTION / AI / ADS</div><div class="wrap scroll">SCROLL TO ROTATE ↓</div></section>
<section class="section" id="services"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">01 — What I make</div><h2>Not random AI shots.<br><span>Actual ad concepts.</span></h2></div><p class="head-copy">The portfolio is now centered on your real direction: AI commercial ads, product storytelling, motion and premium social content.</p></div><div class="service-grid"><article class="service reveal" data-tilt><span class="num">01 / 03</span><span class="outline"></span><h3>AI Commercials</h3><p>Short cinematic product ads with hooks, product beauty shots, motion and a clear commercial idea.</p></article><article class="service reveal" data-tilt><span class="num">02 / 03</span><span class="outline"></span><h3>3D Motion</h3><p>Rotating objects, depth, camera movement, outlined geometry and interactive web presentation.</p></article><article class="service reveal" data-tilt><span class="num">03 / 03</span><span class="outline"></span><h3>Social Ads</h3><p>Vertical-first creative made to feel premium on Instagram, TikTok, Shorts and other social feeds.</p></article></div></div></section>

Scroll. Rotate the scene. The portfolio itself becomes part of the work.</p></div><div class="lab-stamp">drag / scroll<br>explore<br>the system</div></div></div></section>

<section class="section"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">04 — Commercial reels</div><h2>Motion is the <span>proof.</span></h2></div><p class="head-copy">Your two reference videos are included as playable commercial examples in the portable website bundle.</p></div><div class="commercials"><article class="video-card reveal"><video controls playsinline preload="metadata" poster="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><source src="data:video/mp4;base64,
